serverInfo.name: Departi
serverInfo.description: Travel-compliance intelligence and curated booking for digital nomads and long-stay travellers. Coverage: 55 countries (expanding globally) and 100+ destinations.
serverInfo.instructions: Compliance tools provide general information only — not legal or tax advice. To personalize results, register at departi.eu/register (collects nationality, tax residence, employment type, traveler type). Nomad subscription (departi.eu/nomad) unlocks persistent Schengen tracking, tax scenario comparison, and fiscal impact simulation.
